plan.title: Single-stage RFQ required T&C blocks vendor submission

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the required quantity.
Set the requested delivery location.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet required for publication.

args.goal: on the single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, and click Done; stop with the configured event screen visible

steps.note: Configure the event-wise terms with one required and one optional clause.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Confirm the required clause is visible to the vendor.
Confirm the optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept only the optional clause.
Verify submission is blocked while the required clause remains unchecked.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission.
Submit the quote after all required terms are accepted.
Assert that the vendor bid was successfully submitted.
